```python
from collections import Counter

# Each row is size, origin, item type, material, smell, in initial order.
rows = """
extra-small|Russian|brush|ceramic|vinegar
extra-large|Chinese|pencil|glass|wet dog
extra-extra-small|Polish|screwdriver|steel|burning wood
extra-large|Spanish|banana|ceramic|popcorn
extra-small|Polish|house|concrete|lavender
extra-small|Iranian|box|steel|wet dog
extra-small|Portuguese|shoe|plastic|citrus fruits
medium|Iranian|trash can|steel|wet dog
large|Japanese|book|steel|vinegar
extra-extra-small|Japanese|shirt|glass|burning wood
medium|French|lamp|ceramic|coconut
extra-small|Italian|earring|steel|burning wood
extra-large|Brazilian|watch|ceramic|baking bread
extra-large|Canadian|spoon|steel|popcorn
extra-extra-small|Afghan|flower pot|steel|gasoline
extra-extra-large|Turkish|brush|plastic|wet dog
medium|French|wallet|glass|citrus fruits
extra-extra-large|Italian|house|concrete|lavender
extra-extra-small|Italian|bird|steel|baking bread
medium|Polish|banana|concrete|coconut
extra-extra-small|Japanese|candle|plastic|baking bread
extra-small|Italian|plate|steel|burning wood
medium|Afghan|calculator|concrete|pine needles
large|Russian|banana|plastic|popcorn
medium|French|candle|plastic|pine needles
small|Turkish|fork|concrete|burning wood
medium|German|clock|concrete|coffee
extra-extra-small|Canadian|ruler|glass|rose
extra-extra-small|Italian|earring|concrete|freshly cut grass
extra-large|Brazilian|lamp|ceramic|citrus fruits
extra-extra-small|Russian|banana|glass|wet dog
extra-small|Polish|bag|ceramic|vanilla
extra-small|Italian|key|plastic|garlic
extra-extra-small|Canadian|camera|plastic|rose
extra-extra-small|Chinese|piano|concrete|leather
extra-extra-large|Afghan|jar|concrete|vanilla
extra-small|Turkish|candle|concrete|leather
extra-large|Iranian|guitar|concrete|vinegar
""".strip().splitlines()

color_runs = [
    ("beige", 2), ("blue", 3), ("cyan", 3), ("gold", 2),
    ("green", 2), ("indigo", 1), ("ivory", 3), ("khaki", 3),
    ("magenta", 3), ("maroon", 2), ("orange", 1), ("pink", 1),
    ("purple", 1), ("red", 3), ("silver", 2), ("teal", 2),
    ("violet", 2), ("white", 2),
]
colors = [color for color, n in color_runs for _ in range(n)]
assert len(rows) == len(colors) == 38

keys = ("size", "origin", "type", "material", "smell")
initial = [
    dict(zip(keys, row.split("|")), color=color)
    for row, color in zip(rows, colors)
]

target_smells = Counter({
    "vinegar": 9, "wet dog": 5, "burning wood": 5,
    "popcorn": 3, "lavender": 2, "citrus fruits": 3,
    "coconut": 2, "baking bread": 3, "gasoline": 1,
    "pine needles": 2, "coffee": 1, "rose": 2,
    "freshly cut grass": 1, "vanilla": 2, "garlic": 1,
    "leather": 2,
})
target_colors = Counter({
    "beige": 1, "blue": 1, "cyan": 2, "gold": 2,
    "green": 1, "indigo": 1, "ivory": 2, "khaki": 1,
    "magenta": 1, "maroon": 1, "orange": 2, "pink": 1,
    "purple": 1, "red": 3, "silver": 1, "violet": 2,
    "white": 2,
})

def qualifies(item):
    return (
        item["color"] == "blue"
        or item["size"] == "extra-large"
        or item["material"] == "glass"
        or item["smell"] == "vinegar"
        or item["origin"] == "Canadian"
    )

trigger_smells = {"garlic", "lavender", "citrus fruits"}
original_pairs = {(x["smell"], x["color"]) for x in initial}
outcomes = set()
models = []

# Any smell outside the reported smell list would yield an unreported
# positive count. Thus these are all possible cousin favorites.
for cousin_smell in sorted(set(target_smells) - trigger_smells):
    after_cousin = [dict(x) for x in initial]
    after_cousin += [
        dict(x, smell=cousin_smell)
        for x in initial if x["smell"] in trigger_smells
    ]
    if Counter(x["smell"] for x in after_cousin) != target_smells:
        continue

    after_mom = [dict(x) for x in after_cousin]
    after_mom += [
        dict(x, color="ivory", origin="Polish", size="extra-large",
             smell="garlic", material="concrete")
        for x in after_cousin if x["color"] == "teal"
    ]

    type_counts = Counter(x["type"] for x in after_mom)
    survivors = [
        x for x in after_mom if type_counts[x["type"]] % 2 == 1
    ]

    # All unlisted favorite colors are equivalent for testing the
    # reported histogram; one representative exhausts that case.
    candidate_colors = set(colors) | set(target_colors) | {"UNLISTED"}
    for sister_color in sorted(candidate_colors):
        after_sister = [
            dict(x, color=sister_color, smell="rose")
            if x["material"] == "plastic" else dict(x)
            for x in survivors
        ]
        if Counter(x["color"] for x in after_sister) != target_colors:
            continue

        after_fiance = [dict(x) for x in after_sister]
        after_fiance += [
            dict(x) for x in after_sister
            if (x["smell"], x["color"]) not in original_pairs
        ]

        before_loss = sum(qualifies(x) for x in after_fiance)
        losses = [
            i for i, x in enumerate(after_fiance)
            if x["size"] == "extra-large"
        ]
        # Exhaustively consider every permitted lost item.
        model_outcomes = {
            before_loss - int(qualifies(after_fiance[i]))
            for i in losses
        }
        if model_outcomes:
            outcomes.update(model_outcomes)
            models.append((cousin_smell, sister_color,
                           len(after_fiance), before_loss,
                           sorted(model_outcomes)))

print("Consistent models (cousin smell, sister color, size before loss,"
      " qualifying before loss, possible final counts):")
for model in models:
    print(model)

print("Possible final counts:", sorted(outcomes))
if not outcomes:
    print("UNSUPPORTED: no model satisfies all supplied counts")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
elif len(outcomes) == 1:
    print("Expected answer:", next(iter(outcomes)))
    print("CHECK FAIL: submitted answer was unknown")
else:
    print("Expected answer: unknown")
    print("CHECK PASS")
```
